title: Condensed PIPG Sequential Convex Optimization for Reusable-Rocket Powered Landing with Strong Aerodynamics
summary: Reusable-rocket powered landing under strong aerodynamics couples variable mass, free final time, and bounded aerodynamic controls through nonlinear velocity-frame dynamics. This paper develops a condensed proportional--integral projected-gradient (PIPG) sequential-convex method whose principal contribution is an exact reduced-space inner architecture.
